_comment: National party rosters, keyed by the Countries.json name of the nation they stand in. NPCPolitics merges these with the power-keyed ROSTER_PARTIES it carries for the hyperpowers' own benches, so every nation in the world has a ballot: an NPC votes for a party of their OWN home nation (the country of their Destinations.json hometown) or for nobody at all. Names are deliberately distorted off the real ones, exactly as the curated rosters are; ideologyId points at js/i18n/<lang>/ideology.json.
